paragraphs: (1) "Endorsing county" means an endorsing county for purposes of Chapter \[<del>477,</del>\] 478\[<del>, 479,</del>\] or 480.
(2) "Endorsing municipality" means an endorsing municipality for purposes of Chapter \[<del>476, 477,</del>\] 478\[<del>, 479,</del>\] or 480.
(3) "Event" means a game or an event as defined by Chapter 478\[<del>, 479,</del>\] or 480.
(4) "Games" means any of the following and includes the events and activities related to the following:
(B) the Major League Baseball All-Star Game;
(C) the National Basketball Association All-Star Game;
(D) the National Collegiate Athletic Association Final Four;
(E) the National Hockey League All-Star Game;
<ins>(G)</ins> \[<del>(I)</del>\] the World Cup Soccer Games; or
